elements.text: A local research studio for culturally informed music exploration.

End user	Use	Boundary
Listeners	Explore vocal/instrumental raga links	User can correct inferred mood
Students and educators	Inspect source metadata and missing fields	Associations require expert review
AI / MIR researchers	Train models and evaluate feedback loops	Synthetic tests do not show real-world quality
Future study teams	Investigate consented affect/music responses	Clinical use requires separate evidence
Windows CPU execution makes the prototype usable without a GPU or physical sensors.
